implemented: Freezes a bounded stop/target grid and restricts trade and OHLC dates to the development window.
Uses the shared stop-first adverse resolver for same-bar stop/target collisions and exposes collision counts.
Includes declared round-trip cost in every per-trade net outcome and retains all grid/trade rows, including losses.
Rejects invalid bars, final-window access, non-development inputs, and over-budget plans.
Adds a JSON development-trade file runner that checks exact dataset bytes against the frozen plan before and after grid evaluation.
blockers: Dataset digest remains caller-declared and is not bound to an authoritative rights/provenance registry.
Costs are caller-supplied per trade; daily OHLC cannot reveal true intrabar path. Ambiguous stop/target bars are deliberately resolved adversely.
No verified full development study or profitability claim exists.
